verdict: Sysco grew sales 3% and net earnings 11% to $526M as U.S. delivery volumes rose — but the headline profit was flattered by a $234M one-off gain tied to financing its Jetro Restaurant Depot acquisition.

kpis.label: U.S. local case volume
kpis.note: deliveries to local customers rose; total U.S. volume +2.6%

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: cash from operations of $278M minus $48M of net capital spending

segments.name: U.S. Foodservice Operations
segments.note: Food and supplies delivered to U.S. restaurants, schools and hospitals — case volume rose 2.6%, and local (independent customer) volume rose 2.7%.

segments.name: International Foodservice Operations
segments.note: The same delivery business outside the U.S. — sales rose 5.1% (6.0% before currency effects), with double-digit growth in adjusted profit.

segments.name: SYGMA
segments.note: Sysco's chain-restaurant distribution arm, supplying large restaurant chains on contract — sales rose 1.1%.

segments.name: Other
segments.note: Smaller businesses, including guest-supply operations for hotels — sales rose 3.3%.

opex.name: Operating expenses
opex.note: Running the warehouses, trucks and sales teams — up 7.5%, including $108M of acquisition-related costs (mostly for the Jetro Restaurant Depot deal) and $102M of restructuring and transformation costs.

takeaways.title: Volumes are growing again
takeaways.text: U.S. Foodservice local case volume rose 2.7% and total volume 2.6%, driving sales up 2.8% to $21.7B despite soft restaurant foot traffic and only 0.3% food-cost inflation.

takeaways.title: A financing gain props up profit
takeaways.text: Net earnings rose 10.5% to $526M, helped by a $234M gain on rate-lock deals taken out to finance the Jetro Restaurant Depot purchase. Excluding deal items, adjusted EPS was $1.19, up 3.5%.

takeaways.title: Deal costs hit operating profit
takeaways.text: Operating income fell 10.4% to $717M because acquisition, restructuring and transformation costs added $210M to expenses. Before those items, operating income rose 3.2% to $927M.

oneTimers: $234M gain on deal-contingent rate-lock transactions (in other income) taken out to lock in borrowing costs for the Jetro Restaurant Depot acquisition.
$90M of bridge-loan cost amortization inside the $261M of interest expense, also tied to the Jetro deal.
$108M of acquisition-related costs and $102M of restructuring and transformation costs inside operating expenses; adjusted EPS was $1.19 vs $1.09 GAAP.
otherDetail: Other income of -$30M is $261M of interest expense (including the $90M bridge-loan amortization for the Jetro deal) partly offset by $231M of other income, which includes the $234M rate-lock gain.
footerNote: Sysco's fiscal year ends in late June, so this is the first quarter of fiscal 2027. GAAP figures throughout; adjusted figures are shown only in the notes.
